primitiveBudget: one generated planar register, thirty-five unequal plates, one real vacancy per accepted cut, and four liftable re-packs
commitThreshold: one discrete cut on an occupied cell; repeated or empty cells refuse
memoryRule: a cut removes the selected plate and re-produces every surviving plate around the empty coordinate; later cuts compound in order and lift exactly
interactionRule: pointer or touch presses and releases one occupied plate; Arrow keys select, Enter/Space cuts, Delete lifts latest, Escape/R releases, S saves
representationRupture: radial material ring, subtractive relief, and folded sheet -> broad planar register of occupied plates
compositionRupture: one centred body -> distributed 5x7 field with actual holes and re-packed neighbours
encounterRupture: timed press/release and reversible lift -> discrete select-and-cut with no hover-only or duration condition
temporalRupture: phase slip or local subtraction -> ordered vacancy memory that changes the geometry of what remains
mediumRupture: single radial/ribbed bodies -> generated Canvas 2D plate register and substrate voids
changedRule: Material is a count of occupied plates. One discrete cut removes a real unit, then the surviving plates globally re-pack around the vacancy; cut order is part of the production rule.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a dark substrate carrying thirty-five unequal planar plates. A valid cut creates a true empty place and shifts surviving geometry around it; four vacancies persist and reversing order produces a different register.
falsifier: Delete if a cut is only a dark overlay, if neighbouring plates remain fixed, if repeated or empty cells commit, if order changes only a label, if memory resets, if lift is inexact, or if the blind register reads as a generic grid.
deletionCondition: Delete v052 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish a vacancy register from the previous sheet, relief, and ring grammars, or if the empty place cannot carry the work without prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
